statements.text: Roj is the national emblem of the Kurds. The 21-ray form was designed by Mehrdad Izady; 21 is an important number in Yazidism, Yarsanism and Alevism, and the rays symbolise rebirth.
On the flag the yellow sun represents the source of life and light of the people; its 21 rays symbolise the rebirth of the Kurdish nation, identity and dignity.

rays.description: Number of rays. The national emblem has 21; other counts are for design use only.

variant.description: A filled star, or its outline (stroked 1 unit inside the filled edge).

construction: A star polygon with 21 outer and 21 inner vertices, the first outer vertex pointing straight up (rotation -90 degrees).
Inner radius = outer radius / 2, as in the reference flag (spec/flag.json, innerToOuter).

The star's height is R (1 + cos(pi/21)) because the lowest points are the two outer vertices either side of the bottom. Setting the height to the 20-unit live keyline gives R = 20 / (1 + cos(pi/21)) = 10.0562, centre (12, 12.056).
The centre sits 0.056 units below the grid centre, so the visual box (2 to 22) is centred; the same offset appears in the flag, where the sun's centre is at y = 300.842 of 600.
outline: the same star with R reduced by 1, stroked, so the outer stroke edge matches the filled star. At small sizes use stroke width 0.5 to 1.
